findings.title: Latch-off survives the availability substitution
findings.detail: TPS2552DBVR-1 is the active-low latch-off part. The NPN inverter and 100 kOhm pull-up to unswitched 5 V give a dark reset state without a 5 V pull-up on the MCU pin. The suffix -1 must be preserved.

findings.title: Reset also resets the current-limit latch
findings.detail: The manufacturer states that toggling EN or cycling switch power clears the latch. Here MCU reset switches the NPN off and deasserts EN. A boot routine that always re-enables LEDs can therefore retry a previous fault. Specify no automatic retry within a running session, and keep watchdog/software-reset startup dark until the chosen deliberate recovery condition. A stronger cross-reset fault policy requires explicit retained state or a revised circuit; it is not established by selecting -1 alone.

findings.title: ADC fault clamp remains unqualified
findings.detail: Diodes BAS70-04-7-F is the correct procured dual-series candidate. Its 0.41 V maximum drop at 1 mA/25 C does not prove the ADC pin stays above -0.3 V in all faults or at low temperature. Pin voltage, injection current, power-off backfeed and rail absorption need a completed schematic review. The independently reproduced normal DC corners do not close that gate.

findings.title: Nominal capacitance is not effective capacitance
findings.detail: The selected Basic 4.7 uF/16 V X5R capacitors provide nominal margin for the LDO, but DC bias, temperature, tolerance and ageing remain unqualified. The 10 uF/25 V 0805 input and 2x22 uF/25 V 1206 output likewise need operating-point capacitance and layout verification before manufacturing.

findings.title: LED remains Standard Only on rigid boards
findings.detail: C52917434 is listed as Standard Only, High assembly difficulty and MSL5. Changing transparent PET leaves to FR-4 does not make this LED an Economic assembly part. Confirm actual assembler charges on the final jobs.

findings.title: Active TDK LR inductor selected; Wurth retained as fallback
findings.detail: Recovered A4 used Wurth74437324047. A4.1 selects active TDK SPM4020T-4R7M-LR/C694586: same4.7uH±20% and2mm maximum height, with lower price and726stock/719AvailableOrderQty observed2026-11-06 11:37:37JST. Normal0.4–0.5A design load has ample calculated current margin; exact lands and hot startup/upstream-short qualification remain open. Typical3.5A saturation is not a guaranteed hot minimum above the buck3.1A maximum peak limit. See TDK_SPM4020T_4R7M_LR_evaluation.json/md. The obsolete non-LR part is rejected.

findings.title: All 29 quantity and price fields were refreshed separately from history
findings.detail: All 29 recovered MPN/code/quantity/price rows match their saved snapshots. The parent then read all 29 rendered official JLC product pages at 2026-11-06 11:30:39–11:33:52 JST; every stock, Available Order Qty and price tier is retained separately. All cover 100 fitted modules before attrition. The smallest Available Order Qty is 431 Würth inductors. These are point-in-time displays, not reserved parts or an assembly quote.
